text: answer[mkt-1790080148015-81227f]: r/AskHistorians: "What really happened to Jeffrey Epstein?" Top comment: "The official story is that Epstein died by suicide in his MCC cell on August 10, 2019. Guards had failed to check on him for over an hour due to understaffing and shift confusion. But the holes are pretty glaring. He was placed in administrative custody away from his cellmate the night before. The officers who missed him got promoted instead of fired. His body showed laryngeal fractures that didn't perfectly match the hanging theory. And the medical examiner who ruled it suicide was later found to have financial ties to a friend of Epstein's. Whether that points to cover-up or just catastrophic federal negligence, the truth about who really used Epstein as a conduit almost certainly died in his cell with him."
